title: senna crotalarioides
intro: Senna crotalarioides, commonly known as Tanner's Cassia, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as treating constipation, diarrhea, and liver and gallbladder issues. The therapeutic actions of Senna crotalarioides include purgative, anthelmintic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
